Run preprocessing, detrending, and TLS period search on lightcurve: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np import lightkurve as lk import transitleastsquares as tls  path='/root/data/tess_lc.txt' t, f, q, fe = np.genfromtxt(path).T  # 1) filter quality m = (q==0) & np.isfinite(t) & np.isfinite(f) & np.isfinite(fe) t, f, fe = t[m], f[m], fe[m]  # sort just in case idx = np.argsort(t) t, f, fe = t[idx], f[idx], fe[idx]  lc = lk.LightCurve(time=t, flux=f, flux_err=fe)  # Conservative outlier removal (avoid clipping real transits) lc1 = lc.remove_outliers(sigma=10)  # Try a few flatten window lengths; pick by TLS SDE # window_length is in cadences; cadence ~ 2 minutes => 1 day ~ 720 cadences candidates = [801, 1201, 1601, 2001, 3001] results = [] for wl in candidates:     try:         lc_flat = lc1.flatten(window_length=wl, polyorder=2, break_tolerance=5)         # second-pass mild outlier removal after detrending         lc_flat = lc_flat.remove_outliers(sigma=6)         model = tls.transitleastsquares(lc_flat.time.value, lc_flat.flux.value, lc_flat.flux_err.value)         out = model.power(period_min=0.5, period_max=15.0, show_progress_bar=False, verbose=False)         results.append((wl, float(out.SDE), float(out.snr), float(out.period)))         print('wl',wl,'SDE',out.SDE,'snr',out.snr,'period',out.period)     except Exception as e:         print('wl',wl,'FAILED',e)  best = max(results, key=lambda x: x[1]) print('\nBEST',best) PY

Top 10 peaks:') seen=[] for i in ord[:50]:     p=float(periods[i])     # de-duplicate near-equal     if any(abs(p-s)<0.01 for s in seen):         continue     seen.append(p)     print(f"  p={p:.6f}  power={power[i]:.6g}")     if len(seen)>=10:         break  # Refine around best p0=float(out.period) ref=model.power(period_min=p0*0.97, period_max=p0*1.03, oversampling_factor=8,                 show_progress_bar=False, verbose=False) print('
refined period',ref.period,'±',ref.period_uncertainty,'SDE',ref.SDE,'snr',ref.snr)  # Also evaluate half/double neighborhoods with a fresh power call for label, (pmin,pmax) in [     ('half', (p0/2*0.97, p0/2*1.03)),     ('double', (p0*2*0.97, p0*2*1.03)) ]:     tmp=model.power(period_min=pmin, period_max=pmax, oversampling_factor=8,                     show_progress_bar=False, verbose=False)     print(f"{label} period best {tmp.period:.6f} SDE {tmp.SDE:.3f} snr {tmp.snr:.3f}")  # Cross-check with BLS (astropy) on same detrended data # BLS prefers relative times; shift for numerical stability x=(time - time.min())*u.day y=flux bls=BoxLeastSquares(x, y, dy=flux_err) # Search around refined period using durations near TLS duration # duration grid: around tls duration +-50% base_d=float(ref.duration) durations=np.linspace(base_d*0.5, base_d*1.5, 8)*u.day per_grid=np.linspace(float(ref.period)*0.9, float(ref.period)*1.1, 5000)*u.day pg=bls.power(per_grid, durations) ix=np.argmax(pg.power) print('
BLS best period',pg.period[ix].to_value(u.day),'duration',pg.duration[ix].to_value(u.day),'power',pg.power[ix]) PY

Compare TLS solutions near 1.395d and 2.799d periods: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np import lightkurve as lk import transitleastsquares as tls  path='/root/data/tess_lc.txt' t, f, q, fe = np.genfromtxt(path).T m=(q==0) t,f,fe=t[m],f[m],fe[m] idx=np.argsort(t) t,f,fe=t[idx],f[idx],fe[idx]  lc=lk.LightCurve(time=t, flux=f, flux_err=fe) lc=lc.remove_outliers(sigma=10) wl=1601 lc_flat=lc.flatten(window_length=wl, polyorder=2, break_tolerance=5) lc_flat=lc_flat.remove_outliers(sigma=6)  time=lc_flat.time.value flux=lc_flat.flux.value err=lc_flat.flux_err.value   def run_range(pmin,pmax,label):     m=tls.transitleastsquares(time, flux, err)     out=m.power(period_min=pmin, period_max=pmax, oversampling_factor=10, show_progress_bar=False, verbose=False)     keys=['period','period_uncertainty','SDE','snr','depth','duration','T0','transit_count','distinct_transit_count','odd_even_mismatch','depth_odd','depth_even']     print('\n',label,'range',pmin,pmax)     for k in keys:         if hasattr(out,k):             print(k, getattr(out,k))     return out  out1=run_range(1.2,1.6,'near-1.4d') out2=run_range(2.4,3.2,'near-2.8d')  PY

Run global BLS search on detrended curve and refine peak: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np import lightkurve as lk from astropy.timeseries import BoxLeastSquares import astropy.units as u  path='/root/data/tess_lc.txt' t, f, q, fe = np.genfromtxt(path).T m=(q==0) t,f,fe=t[m],f[m],fe[m] idx=np.argsort(t) t,f,fe=t[idx],f[idx],fe[idx]  lc=lk.LightCurve(time=t, flux=f, flux_err=fe) lc=lc.remove_outliers(sigma=10) wl=1601 lc_flat=lc.flatten(window_length=wl, polyorder=2, break_tolerance=5) lc_flat=lc_flat.remove_outliers(sigma=6)  # BLS wants times with units t_rel=(lc_flat.time.value - lc_flat.time.value.min())*u.day flux=lc_flat.flux.value err=lc_flat.flux_err.value  bls=BoxLeastSquares(t_rel, flux, dy=err) # durations: 0.05-0.25 days (1.2h - 6h) durations=np.linspace(0.05,0.25,12)*u.day pg=bls.autopower(durations, minimum_period=0.5*u.day, maximum_period=15*u.day, objective='snr') ix=int(np.argmax(pg.power)) best_p=pg.period[ix].to_value(u.day) best_d=pg.duration[ix].to_value(u.day) best_t0=pg.transit_time[ix].to_value(u.day) print('BLS global best period',best_p,'dur',best_d,'t0',best_t0,'snr-like',pg.power[ix])  # Check top few distinct peaks ord=np.argsort(pg.power)[::-1] seen=[] print('\nTop peaks (distinct by 0.01d):') for j in ord[:200]:     p=float(pg.period[j].to_value(u.day))     if any(abs(p-s)<0.01 for s in seen):         continue     seen.append(p)     print(f"p={p:.6f}  power={pg.power[j]:.4f}  dur={pg.duration[j].to_value(u.day):.4f}")     if len(seen)>=8:         break  # Fine refinement around best pgrid=np.linspace(best_p*0.995, best_p*1.005, 20000)*u.day pg2=bls.power(pgrid, durations, objective='snr') ix2=int(np.argmax(pg2.power)) ref_p=pg2.period[ix2].to_value(u.day) print('\nBLS refined best period',ref_p,'power',pg2.power[ix2])  PY

Check BLS best period stability across detrending window lengths: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np import lightkurve as lk from astropy.timeseries import BoxLeastSquares import astropy.units as u  path='/root/data/tess_lc.txt' t, f, q, fe = np.genfromtxt(path).T m=(q==0) t,f,fe=t[m],f[m],fe[m] idx=np.argsort(t) t,f,fe=t[idx],f[idx],fe[idx]  lc=lk.LightCurve(time=t, flux=f, flux_err=fe) lc=lc.remove_outliers(sigma=10)  for wl in [801, 1201, 1601, 2001, 3001]:     lc_flat=lc.flatten(window_length=wl, polyorder=2, break_tolerance=5)     lc_flat=lc_flat.remove_outliers(sigma=6)     t_rel=(lc_flat.time.value - lc_flat.time.value.min())*u.day     flux=lc_flat.flux.value     err=lc_flat.flux_err.value     bls=BoxLeastSquares(t_rel, flux, dy=err)     durations=np.linspace(0.05,0.35,15)*u.day     pg=bls.autopower(durations, minimum_period=0.5*u.day, maximum_period=15*u.day, objective='snr')     ix=int(np.argmax(pg.power))     print('wl',wl,'bestP',pg.period[ix].to_value(u.day),'dur',pg.duration[ix].to_value(u.day),'power',pg.power[ix]) PY

Compute BLS statistics for candidate and doubled periods: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np import lightkurve as lk from astropy.timeseries import BoxLeastSquares import astropy.units as u  path='/root/data/tess_lc.txt' t, f, q, fe = np.genfromtxt(path).T m=(q==0) t,f,fe=t[m],f[m],fe[m] idx=np.argsort(t) t,f,fe=t[idx],f[idx],fe[idx]  wl=2001 lc=lk.LightCurve(time=t, flux=f, flux_err=fe) lc=lc.remove_outliers(sigma=10) lc_flat=lc.flatten(window_length=wl, polyorder=2, break_tolerance=5).remove_outliers(sigma=6)  t_rel=(lc_flat.time.value - lc_flat.time.value.min())*u.day flux=lc_flat.flux.value err=lc_flat.flux_err.value  bls=BoxLeastSquares(t_rel, flux, dy=err) durations=np.linspace(0.05,0.45,20)*u.day pg=bls.autopower(durations, minimum_period=0.5*u.day, maximum_period=15*u.day, objective='snr') ix=int(np.argmax(pg.power)) P=float(pg.period[ix].to_value(u.day)) D=float(pg.duration[ix].to_value(u.day)) T0=float(pg.transit_time[ix].to_value(u.day)) print('best P',P,'D',D,'T0',T0,'power',pg.power[ix])  stats=bls.compute_stats(P*u.day, D*u.day, T0*u.day) print('\nStats at P:') for k in ['depth','depth_err','depth_snr','transit_count','depth_odd','depth_even','depth_half','depth_double','duration','transit_times']:     if k in stats:         v=stats[k]         if hasattr(v,'to_value'):             v=v.to_value(u.day) if k=='duration' else v         print(k, v if k!='transit_times' else f"{len(v)} times") print('odd-even diff', float(stats['depth_odd']-stats['depth_even']))  # Now test doubled period; find best duration/T0 for 2P by scanning Pd=2*P per_grid=np.linspace(Pd*0.98, Pd*1.02, 4000)*u.day pgd=bls.power(per_grid, durations, objective='snr') ixd=int(np.argmax(pgd.power)) Pd_best=float(pgd.period[ixd].to_value(u.day)) Dd_best=float(pgd.duration[ixd].to_value(u.day)) T0d=float(pgd.transit_time[ixd].to_value(u.day)) print('\nBest near 2P:',Pd_best,'D',Dd_best,'T0',T0d,'power',pgd.power[ixd]) statsd=bls.compute_stats(Pd_best*u.day, Dd_best*u.day, T0d*u.day) print('Stats at ~2P: depth_snr',statsd['depth_snr'],'transit_count',statsd['transit_count'],'odd-even diff', float(statsd['depth_odd']-statsd['depth_even'])) PY

Compare BLS peak powers at P and 2P for selection: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np import lightkurve as lk from astropy.timeseries import BoxLeastSquares import astropy.units as u  path='/root/data/tess_lc.txt' t,f,q,fe=np.genfromtxt(path).T m=q==0 t,f,fe=t[m],f[m],fe[m] idx=np.argsort(t) t,f,fe=t[idx],f[idx],fe[idx]  wl=2001 lc=lk.LightCurve(time=t, flux=f, flux_err=fe).remove_outliers(sigma=10) lc_flat=lc.flatten(window_length=wl, polyorder=2, break_tolerance=5).remove_outliers(sigma=6)  t_rel=(lc_flat.time.value-lc_flat.time.value.min())*u.day flux=lc_flat.flux.value err=lc_flat.flux_err.value bls=BoxLeastSquares(t_rel, flux, dy=err) durations=np.linspace(0.05,0.45,20)*u.day  # best P from global search pg=bls.autopower(durations, minimum_period=0.5*u.day, maximum_period=15*u.day, objective='snr') ix=int(np.argmax(pg.power)) P=float(pg.period[ix].to_value(u.day)) powerP=float(pg.power[ix])  # best around 2P P2_center=2*P per_grid=np.linspace(P2_center*0.98, P2_center*1.02, 20000)*u.day pg2=bls.power(per_grid, durations, objective='snr') ix2=int(np.argmax(pg2.power)) P2=float(pg2.period[ix2].to_value(u.day)) powerP2=float(pg2.power[ix2])  print('P',P,'power',powerP) print('2P',P2,'power',powerP2) print('power ratio P/(2P)',powerP/powerP2) PY

Refine BLS best period for several detrending windows precisely: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np import lightkurve as lk from astropy.timeseries import BoxLeastSquares import astropy.units as u  path='/root/data/tess_lc.txt' t,f,q,fe=np.genfromtxt(path).T m=q==0 t,f,fe=t[m],f[m],fe[m] idx=np.argsort(t) t,f,fe=t[idx],f[idx],fe[idx]  lc0=lk.LightCurve(time=t, flux=f, flux_err=fe).remove_outliers(sigma=10)  durations=np.linspace(0.05,0.45,20)*u.day  for wl in [1201,1601,2001,3001]:     lc=lc0.flatten(window_length=wl, polyorder=2, break_tolerance=5).remove_outliers(sigma=6)     t_rel=(lc.time.value-lc.time.value.min())*u.day     bls=BoxLeastSquares(t_rel, lc.flux.value, dy=lc.flux_err.value)     pg=bls.autopower(durations, minimum_period=0.5*u.day, maximum_period=15*u.day, objective='snr')     ix=int(np.argmax(pg.power))     P0=float(pg.period[ix].to_value(u.day))     # fine grid ±0.3%     pgrid=np.linspace(P0*(1-0.003), P0*(1+0.003), 60000)*u.day     pg2=bls.power(pgrid, durations, objective='snr')     ix2=int(np.argmax(pg2.power))     P=float(pg2.period[ix2].to_value(u.day))     print('wl',wl,'P0',P0,'Pref',P,'power',float(pg2.power[ix2])) PY

Finalize precise BLS period near peak using likelihood objective: $ python3 - <<'PY' import numpy as np import lightkurve as lk from astropy.timeseries import BoxLeastSquares import astropy.units as u  path='/root/data/tess_lc.txt' t,f,q,fe=np.genfromtxt(path).T m=q==0 t,f,fe=t[m],f[m],fe[m] idx=np.argsort(t) t,f,fe=t[idx],f[idx],fe[idx]  wl=2001 lc=lk.LightCurve(time=t, flux=f, flux_err=fe).remove_outliers(sigma=10) lc=lc.flatten(window_length=wl, polyorder=2, break_tolerance=5).remove_outliers(sigma=6)  t_rel=(lc.time.value-lc.time.value.min())*u.day bls=BoxLeastSquares(t_rel, lc.flux.value, dy=lc.flux_err.value)  durations=np.linspace(0.05,0.45,20)*u.day # get coarse best with likelihood pg=bls.autopower(durations, minimum_period=0.5*u.day, maximum_period=15*u.day, objective='likelihood') ix=int(np.argmax(pg.power)) P0=float(pg.period[ix].to_value(u.day)) print('coarse best (likelihood)',P0,'dur',float(pg.duration[ix].to_value(u.day)))  # refine with a narrow grid +/-0.2% pgrid=np.linspace(P0*(1-0.002), P0*(1+0.002), 80000)*u.day pg2=bls.power(pgrid, durations, objective='likelihood') ix2=int(np.argmax(pg2.power)) P=float(pg2.period[ix2].to_value(u.day)) print('refined best (likelihood)',P,'dur',float(pg2.duration[ix2].to_value(u.day)),'power',float(pg2.power[ix2])) PY
